title: Calibrating Prediction Timeliness Through Multi-Objective Hyperparameter Optimization for Remaining Useful Life Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.01530v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In predictive maintenance, early and late RUL prediction errors carry asymmetric consequences, yet hyperparameter optimization typically targets a single accuracy metric that treats both directions equally. This study treats the optimization objective itself as a design variable. Five architectures (MLP, LSTM, XGBoost, TCN, and Transformer) are evaluated under three regimes: single-objective maximization of $R^2$, single-objective minimization of the NASA scoring function, and a multi-objective formulation that jointly optimizes both criteria. The multi-objective search employs NSGA-II with Entropy-CRITIC weighting for Pareto selection. Seventy-five model-dataset-strategy combinations are assessed on the NASA C-MAPSS turbofan and BackBlaze hard-disk drive benchmarks. translated_title: 通过多目标超参数优化校准剩余使用寿命预测的时效性
translated_abstract: 在预测性维护中，剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测的过早误差和过晚误差会带来不对称的后果，然而超参数优化通常只针对单一的精度指标，对两个方向的误差同等对待。本研究将优化目标本身视为一个设计变量，在三种机制下评估了五种架构（MLP、LSTM、XGBoost、TCN和Transformer）：单目标最大化R²、单目标最小化NASA评分函数，以及联合优化这两个准则的多目标形式。多目标搜索采用NSGA-II算法，并结合Entropy-CRITIC加权进行Pareto选择。研究在NASA C-MAPSS涡扇发动机和BackBlaze硬盘驱动器两个基准数据集上评估了75种模型-数据集-策略组合。在C-MAPSS上，所有策略均达到相当的精度（R² ≈ 0.89），但多目标优化将方向性不平衡降低了约33%，改进了…（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文创新性地将优化目标本身作为设计变量，采用NSGA-II结合Entropy-CRITIC加权的多目标超参数优化来同时平衡R²精度与NASA评分函数，在保持精度相当的前提下将RUL预测的方向性不平衡降低约33%。
en_tdlr: This paper innovatively treats the optimization objective itself as a design variable, employing NSGA-II with Entropy-CRITIC weighting for multi-objective hyperparameter optimization that jointly balances R² accuracy and the NASA scoring function, reducing directional imbalance in RUL prediction by approximately 33% while maintaining comparable accuracy.
